model_or_product: LRE Fuzz Sound / Lafayette Fuzz Sound
flag_note: The Lafayette 1968 catalog documents the Fuzz Sound as an imported guitar/bass fuzz with a two-control layout and a 1.5V penlight-battery specification. This provides a period U.S. catalog anchor for the LRE-marketed pedal; the catalog does not name its Japanese factory.

model_or_product: U-1095 Super Fuzz / Uni-Wah manufacturing lineage
flag_note: Recent historical research argues that the post-1969 Univox U-1095 Super Fuzz came from the same Japanese manufacturer as the Uni-Wah, and that this manufacturer is probably the maker Unicord used for the earlier LRE Fuzz Sound. The manufacturer remains unnamed, so this is preserved as a high-priority lineage lead rather than a factory attribution.

model_or_product: Melos FS-1 Fuzzder / LRE Fuzz Sound family
flag_note: Effects Database directly groups Melos FS-1 with LRE, Apollo, Mica, Monacor and Olson variants. Current historical research further suggests Melos may have been a house brand of the still-unidentified Japanese manufacturer behind the LRE/Uni-Wah/U-1095 corridor. Preserve as a hypothesis only.
